predictions.selection_reason: user-controlled data-youtube and data-ytparams attributes -> innerHTML assignment -> potential XSS via iframe src injection
predictions.source_summary: id from elem.getAttribute('data-youtube'), youtubeParams from elem.getAttribute('data-ytparams') - both HTML attributes controlled by page content/developers
predictions.sink_summary: innerHTML assignment creating iframe with dynamically constructed src attribute
predictions.guard_summary: Only checks if youtubeParams starts with '&' (regAmp=/^&/), no validation/sanitization of id or youtubeParams values
predictions.risk_pattern: User/developer-controlled HTML attributes directly concatenated into iframe src URL parameters without validation, then assigned via innerHTML
enclosing_conditions: if(youtubeParams && !regAmp.test(youtubeParams)) - only adds '&' prefix if missing
predictions.context_summary: YouTube video embed handler that constructs iframe src from template URL with user-provided video ID and parameters
unresolved_facts: Whether YouTube's embed domain restricts malicious parameter values
Whether the hosting page sanitizes data-youtube/data-ytparams attributes before setting them

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: client-side URL construction with untrusted parameters leading to iframe content manipulation
retrieval_query.sensitive_operation: iframe src URL construction with concatenated query parameters
retrieval_query.impact: content spoofing, open redirect, JavaScript injection

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Writing incompletely sanitized values to HTML attribute strings can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL). Use Content Security Policy and validate input.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
top_sast_rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against allowlists. Use relative URLs where possible and avoid user-controlled redirects.
